freePlan.limits: Entirely free and open source, no limitations or paid tier; licensed under GNU GPL v3 or later.

keyLimits.en: Entirely free, no limitations, GNU GPL v3 licensed.

capabilities.en: Non-destructive RAW photo processing and development using a caching architecture: edits apply only at export time, originals stay untouched.
Database-driven image management with a zoomable lighttable interface for browsing and organizing large photo collections.
Modules ranging from basic adjustments (crop, exposure) to advanced color and effect processing, using rawspeed for camera RAW decoding.
Tethered shooting support, described by the project as one of the few free/open-source tools offering this capability.
Floating-point processing pipeline that also supports scientific/non-photography imaging use cases.

limitations.en: No official mobile app; darktable is a desktop-only application.
Being community-maintained open source software, support relies on documentation and community forums rather than a commercial support line.

reason.en: Leading commercial RAW processing and photo management tool, the main alternative darktable is positioned against.
Professional commercial RAW editor with similar non-destructive workflow, a direct paid alternative.
Commercial RAW processing software with advanced optical corrections, competing on image quality.

unknowns: Exact list of currently supported camera RAW formats/models not verified (referenced via a separate camera support page not fetched in this session).
